RECLASSIFIED, not a bug. Investigation (2026-04-10 arch pass) discovered the original bug report was wrong: String.length/1 in Elixir 1.18.4 IS grapheme-aware. Direct verification: returns 1 for ZWJ family emoji (5 codepoints), 1 for flag emoji (2 codepoints), 4 for both precomposed and decomposed 'café'. The pre-fix Diff code was already grapheme-correct in practice. Commit 97cc81f lands as a consistency refactor (length(chars) on the already-split grapheme list from List.myers_difference, avoiding a redundant walk via Enum.join + String.length). Four regression tests for combining marks, ZWJ, flag emoji, and no-op idempotence are kept as coverage. docs/known-gaps.md T2 and the Closed section have been updated with the correct story. Notified commonplace-plan to revert the over-softened wording in views.md Diff contract section (they softened based on my incorrect bug claim via clod-squad #1377).
